state: B1-12 qualifies Markdown rendering for Can atop pinned Bun 1.4.2. Bun.markdown.html emits raw strings: scripts and javascript: URLs survive unless noHtmlBlocks and noHtmlSpans request escaping. Bun.markdown.render drives synchronous callbacks combined by string concatenation. Observed callback payloads: text sees source verbatim; heading adds level; link adds href and title; image adds src and title; code adds language or null; codespan, strong, emphasis, strikethrough, paragraph, blockquote and hr pass children through. Three fidelity holes are measured: list delivers a single flattened string per nesting level annotated only with ordered and depth, table delivers one flattened string with no row or cell seams, and breaks deliver no signal. Raw block markup triggers the html callback whereas raw span markup flows in as text; footnote and similar extensions collapse to text; NUL bytes split text around U+FFFD so no NUL reaches callbacks; callback exceptions propagate verbatim; bogus options and callbacks are ignored. Only the html.ts factory mints html::safe via async text, makeTag, element, textAttribute, urlAttribute, parseURL and fragment steps, and only html::safe enters response_html. Its allowlists today omit code, pre, blockquote, img and del from authorTags, omit img from voidTags, and omit src from urlAttribute and the element URL table, while parseURL limits targets to https and local and bars control bytes, backslashes and credentials. The build splits into synchronous tag-tree capture using NUL tokens the engine cannot forge, then asynchronous validated assembly through the factory. Regex sanitization marketed as safe is prohibited, and Promise values must never render into callback output. Fixed standaloneBytes budgets are the codec precedent.

safe_mode_scope.instructions: Choose the B1-12 safe rendering scope.

criteria.blocked: Defer typed safe output with a reproducer and deliver strings only, given unrecoverable list and table structure.
criteria.safe_subset: Deliver safe prose, code, links and images now while lists, tables and raw blocks fail closed explicitly.
criteria.full_flattened: Deliver everything with lists and tables silently collapsed into paragraph text.

raw_block_policy.instructions: Decide the raw-block rule for safe rendering.

criteria.reject: Unsupported-element failure for any raw block encountered.
criteria.escape_paragraph: Visible escaped paragraph showing the block source text.
criteria.strip_silent: Silent removal of raw blocks from safe output.

criteria.fixed_standalone: Built-in standaloneBytes input/output ceilings matching the codecs.
criteria.caller_limits: Explicit caller-passed limits validated on every render.
